skill.name: audit
skill.description: Run a structured codebase audit for TODOs, deprecated code, type issues, architecture problems, and code smells.
skill.summary: Guide a read-only codebase audit with severity-ranked findings and a markdown report.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss TODOs, type gaps, deprecated code, and architectural drift. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a systematic read-only audit.
actual_capabilities: Guides scoped file discovery before review begins.
Creates a markdown audit report under the .audit directory.
Checks for TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, and deprecated markers.
Reviews files for type issues, code smells, deprecations, and architecture anti-patterns.
Summarizes findings by severity, category, and top critical issues.
Suggests TypeScript, lint, and build checks when project tooling exists.
limitations: It does not fix code or create implementation plans.
It depends on available project tools and scripts.
Architecture and naming findings require manual judgment.
Project commands can be risky in untrusted repositories.

use_cases.title: Pre-Release Quality Review
use_cases.description: Find maintainability issues before a release branch is finalized.

use_cases.title: Legacy Code Assessment
use_cases.description: Map TODOs, deprecated patterns, type gaps, and code smells in older modules.

use_cases.title: Architecture Drift Check
use_cases.description: Identify cross-file patterns, coupling problems, and inconsistent implementation choices.

prompt_templates.title: Audit This Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this repository for TODOs, FIXMEs, deprecated code, type issues, and major code smells. Create the report in .audit and do not edit source files.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Specific Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the selected folder for quality issues, missing types, duplicated logic, and outdated patterns. Include severity, category, and file references.

prompt_templates.title: Review Architecture Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the codebase for architecture anti-patterns, circular dependencies, tight coupling, and inconsistent patterns. Summarize systemic issues first.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Release Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the codebase for release risk. Include automated tool results when safe, then rank the top critical and high findings.

output_examples.input: Audit the repository for quality and technical debt.
output_examples.output: A markdown audit report with an executive summary, issue counts, top critical findings, category sections, and automated tool results.

output_examples.input: Audit the API package for architecture problems.
output_examples.output: A focused report listing coupling concerns, inconsistent patterns, affected files, severity labels, and cross-file observations.

output_examples.input: Check for TODOs, deprecated code, and type problems.
output_examples.output: A categorized findings list with severity, file references, and summaries for TODOs, deprecations, and type issues.

best_practices: Define the audit scope before starting file review.
Keep the audit read-only unless fixes are requested separately.
Run local diagnostics only when project scripts are trusted and available.
anti_patterns: Asking for fixes during the same audit pass.
Running untrusted project scripts without reviewing them.
Skipping generated or legacy files without documenting the reason.

faq.question: Does this skill edit my code?
faq.answer: No. The instructions require read-only analysis and a separate report.

faq.question: Where is the audit report created?
faq.answer: The skill asks the assistant to create a markdown report in the .audit directory.

faq.question: Can it run TypeScript and lint checks?
faq.answer: Yes, when project tooling exists and command execution is approved.

faq.question: What issues does it look for?
faq.answer: It looks for deprecations, TODOs, type issues, code smells, and architecture anti-patterns.

faq.question: Is it only for TypeScript projects?
faq.answer: No. TypeScript checks are included, but the audit process can review many codebases.

faq.question: Does it provide remediation plans?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on identifying and reporting problems, not planning fixes.
